name: arrow_impact_flesh
for: archer / bounty_echo arrows hitting the hero (body hit)
notes: Arrowhead punching into flesh, drawn for an arrow travelling +x: a hard pale 4-point hit star and 1-frame hit-stop, then a spray of dark-red droplets driven on through (+x) and arcing down, a few flung back out of the wound, and 2-3 wood splinters off the shaft. Anchor = where the arrowhead struck. Mirror with the shot's direction.
